components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Black primary action, one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111113; color: #fff; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; transition: transform .12s ease, background-color .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3d3d42; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111113; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White button with a near-ink outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #111113; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(17,17,19,.8); border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; transition: background-color .18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f6f6f5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111113; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline field, ink border and yellow halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 220px; background: #fff; color: #111113; border: 1px solid #e5e5e7; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 13.5px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #77777e; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(17,17,19,.4); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #111113; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,229,59,.55); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small tinted chip with dot and label.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(31,157,85,.1); color: #1f9d55; font: 500 11.5px/16px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White 8px card with hairline border and ruled header.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e5e7; border-radius: 8px; color: #111113; font: 400 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-card header { padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #efeff1; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; padding: 20px; }

components.name: Stat Strip
components.description: Hairline-divided metrics; the pink cell needs a person.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1px; width: 360px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e5e5e7; border-radius: 8px; background: #e5e5e7; } .ds-strip div { background: #fff; padding: 16px; } .ds-strip span { display: block; font: 400 12px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; color: #77777e; } .ds-strip b { margin-top: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 28px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #111113; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-strip .a b { color: #e03a6b; } .ds-strip i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e03a6b; }

components.name: Underline Tabs
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e7; } .ds-tabs button { background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 4px 0 8px; font: 500 13px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; color: #77777e; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: #111113; } .ds-tabs button.on { color: #111113; border-bottom-color: #111113; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav
components.description: Light sidebar with a collapsible group and a yellow count badge.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #e5e5e7; padding: 12px; width: 240px; display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav a { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #3d3d42; font: 400 13.5px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #f6f6f5; color: #111113; } .ds-nav a.on { background: #f6f6f5; color: #111113; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav b { background: #ffe53b; color: #111113; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0 6px; font: 600 11px/20px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-nav .sub { margin-left: 22px; padding-left: 8px; border-left: 1px solid #e5e5e7; } .ds-nav .sub a { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: #77777e; }

narrative.overview: Cadence is a clean neutral product UI: white work surfaces on a pale grey ground, near-black ink, black primary buttons, hairline borders. Nothing is decorated. Colour is rationed so an organizer scanning between other tasks reads state before words: yellow marks the single thing to look at, pink means a person is needed, purple means in progress or open, green means settled.
keyCharacteristics: Pale grey canvas, white surfaces, 1px hairline borders, no resting shadows.
Black primary button, outlined secondary; underline tabs; tinted small status chips.
Yellow = the one highlight; pink = needs a person; purple = in progress/open; green = settled.
Light sidebar with collapsible sub-navigation, top bar with command search, event select and bell, then a breadcrumb row.
Hanken Grotesk and Noto Sans Malayalam only.

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks the single thing to look at on a screen (count, range floor, empty icon). It is never a fill for large areas or a second action colour.

rules.name: The Pink Means A Person Rule
rules.body: Pink marks what needs a human and nothing else.

rules.name: The Meaning-Not-Mood Rule
rules.body: Tones come from labels.ts; ring colours come from GROUPS in OutcomeChart.tsx. Do not pick a tone ad hoc.

rules.name: The Hatch Rule
rules.body: An uncertain share of a bar is a diagonal grey hatch, meaning "not yet known".

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Counts and rates are tabular so strips and tables align.

rules.name: The Two-Script Rule
rules.body: Never clip or truncate Malayalam; give it line-height room.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with canvas/surface steps and 1px lines before reaching for a shadow.

dos: Do keep pages white-on-grey with 1px lines; radii at 5 / 6 / 8px.
Do make the black primary button the single main action per view.
Do use Pink only for items needing a human and Yellow for one highlight per area.
Do show status as a tinted chip with dot and label, tone from labels.ts.
Do give any outcome chart a table or legend with the same data.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; mask phone numbers and mark simulated activity visibly.
donts: Don't add another saturated colour without a meaning to attach to it.
Don't use yellow or pink as decoration or as large fills.
Don't truncate or clip Malayalam text.
Don't hard-code status colours outside the semantic set.
Don't add resting card shadows or a second typeface.
